style: Cozy storybook illustration for a top-down 3/4-view mobile game about a small robot restoring Florida scrub. Match the existing Scrub Bot art: finely painted botanical detail for nature, rounded and gentle shapes, warm coloured outlines (never black), light from the upper-left, a sun-bleached palette of sand creams, sage and olive greens and dusty blues with small warm accents. Painterly but clean; readable when shown small. Transparent PNG background unless noted.
delivery: Deliver each asset as public/art/<key>.png at 4x its logical size (the 'pixels' field), sRGB. Add the key to public/art/manifest.json and its logical size to src/art/catalog.json, then run npm run art:check. The game swaps in the illustration automatically.

assets.prompt: A small cluster of wildfire flames burning one patch of scrub: three or four rounded tongues of flame in deep orange, tangerine and buttery yellow around a pale cream core, a faint warm glow at the base. Storybook-campfire friendly rather than frightening.
mustShow: Flames only, rising from the bottom edge
Bright enough to read on pale sand
assets.notes: The game flickers and scales it. Optional extra frames wildfire_1 and wildfire_2 on the same canvas would allow true animation.

assets.prompt: A soft, rounded puff of grey-lavender woodsmoke, semi-transparent (about 50% opacity), slightly lighter at the top-left.
mustShow: Feathered edges that fade to transparent

assets.prompt: A single glowing orange ember with a soft radial halo. Also stretched by the game into the warm glow under flames, so keep it radially soft.

A top-down patch of freshly burned ground: soft ash-grey and soot-brown blotches, scattered white ash flecks, one or two tiny orange embers, and charred grass stubble. Feathered edges that fade into the sand. Used as a ground stamp at random rotations, so it must look natural at any angle.
A short strip of freshly raked bare sand seen from above: parallel rake furrows in tan and light brown, a few raked-up twigs at the edges, feathered outline.
A charred root crown at ground level with bright new green shoots sprouting from it: the first week after fire, when scrub oaks and saw palmettos resprout from their roots.
mustShow: Blackened stump base with a soft contact shadow
Five to seven fresh, small green shoots

assets.prompt: One falling raindrop streak: a thin pale-blue line with a brighter head and a soft tail.
A shallow rain puddle on sand from above, reflecting pale sky blue, with a soft wet darker rim that fades into the ground.
A small curled dry scrub-oak leaf in tan and russet, tumbling in the wind.
avoid: Lobed northern oak or maple leaf

assets.prompt: A single soft pink wildflower petal drifting on the spring breeze.
A fluffy, silky white cogon-grass seed with a tiny brown seed at its base, floating on summer wind.
A stylised lightning bolt striking down: a chunky cream-white jagged bolt with a pale yellow glow, slightly tapered toward the bottom where it hits the ground.
mustShow: Glow fading to transparent around the bolt

assets.prompt: A long, soft horizontal band of morning mist: very low-contrast white with feathered edges on every side, almost invisible on its own.
A tiny glowing yellow-green firefly light: a bright dot with a soft halo.
A delicate pale-blue frost sparkle for a Florida cold snap: a six-point twinkle.
A half-deflated foil heart balloon that blew in on a storm and snagged on the sand, with a curly pink ribbon trailing on the ground. Muted pink foil with a soft highlight and a contact shadow.
A crumpled translucent white plastic grocery bag lying flat on sand, with soft folds and a contact shadow.
A crushed red soda can lying on its side in the sand, silver rim and a dent, contact shadow.

A Florida gopher frog (Lithobates capito) sitting at a burrow: a stout, chunky frog with a large head, creamy tan to grey body densely covered in dark brown irregular spots, warty skin, big round golden eyes with dark pupils, gentle expression.
mustShow: Dense dark spots on pale skin

assets.prompt: A gopher tortoise scarab (Onthophagus polyphemi): a tiny, rounded, glossy dark brown-black dung beetle with finely ridged wing covers and stout, spiny front legs for digging.
A camel cricket (Ceuthophilus) from a tortoise burrow: humpbacked and wingless, mottled pale tan and brown, with extremely long antennae and long, spiny, bent hind legs.

A rounded-square field-guide vignette of a gentle prescribed burn creeping low through wiregrass and saw palmetto under a blue sky, soft smoke drifting, fresh green shoots in the foreground. Hopeful, not scary.
mustShow: Rounded corners with a transparent outside
assets.notes: Opaque inside a rounded card; the corners outside the rounding must stay transparent.

assets.prompt: A rounded-square vignette of a Florida summer thunderhead over the scrub: a towering cloud, a single lightning bolt, and a grey curtain of rain over palmettos.
mustShow: Rounded corners with a transparent outside

assets.prompt: A rounded-square vignette of the habitat edge: a road and a fence line where the scrub begins, fluffy invasive seeds drifting in on the wind, and a pink natal-grass tuft growing by the roadside.
mustShow: Rounded corners with a transparent outside

assets.prompt: A side-view cross-section of a gopher tortoise burrow for the burrow-scope mini-game: a thin strip of sky and scrub at the top, the burrow's sandy apron at the top-left, then layered pale-to-tan sand that grows warmer and darker with depth, a few roots hanging down, and a tortoise-shell-wide dark-brown tunnel sloping down in an S-curve to a rounded resting chamber near the bottom. Leave the tunnel empty: the game places the animals.
mustShow: The tunnel must follow this path in the 180×320 logical canvas: M30 40 C130 90 30 170 120 220 Q160 245 120 285
Rounded corners (about 12 logical px) with a transparent outside
assets.notes: The game darkens everything except a moving circle of light, so mid-tones read best.

assets.prompt: A top-down close-up of pale Florida scrub sand for the rhizome-dig mini-game: fine quartz grains, a few tiny pebbles and bits of leaf litter, very low contrast so that the game's white runner lines stand out on top.
mustShow: Rounded corners (about 14 logical px) with a transparent outside
avoid: Plants, roots or lines (the game draws them)
